frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: Hail, brave traveller! What brings you to the barren lands of Ampiforia?

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: I’m on a mission to stop the Grand Composer and restore harmony to the galaxy!

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: Indeed, we heard the techno booms and awaited your visit. The name's Gnork, I admire your courage.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: Nice to meet you, Gnork. What happened to Ampiforia?

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: The composer's grip is stronger here, traveller. Our rock music was too powerful. He silenced our heavy jamming, so we've turned to mining jewels deep in the caves. But there's still hope!

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: Deep in the mines lies the beating heart of our planet, a legendary jewel called the Thunderstone. It's dormant now; only the most hardcore rock musician can bring back its power and refuel our rock spirit.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: Where can I find this Thunderstone?

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: The Thunderstone is hidden deep within Core Cavern. It’s guarded by the fierce warrior, Lightningfist. He once fed on the rebel energy of the Thunderstone, and now lies waiting for its resurgence.

frames.heading: Traveller (You)
frames.body: I'll do anything it takes for Ampiforia to rock again.

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: Rock on, traveller! I'd be glad to accompany you on this quest. But first, show me what you've got!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Hey Player! Another symbol just dropped...

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: When the PEACE symbol appears, raise your index and middle fingers and chill out!
